mechanism: Olanzapine has some serotonergic activity and isocarboxazid is an MAOI; combined use increases risk of serotonin syndrome, and both drugs cause CNS depression and orthostatic hypotension.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution, monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, rigidity, hyperthermia), and educate patient on dietary tyramine restrictions.
